description: Na₃GaSe₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.54 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.42 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Se²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent GaSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GaSe₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 54°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.57 Å. Ga³⁺ is bonded to four Se²⁻ atoms to form GaSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GaSe₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-55°. There are a spread of Ga-Se bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.48 Å. There are three inequivalent Se²⁻ sites. In the first Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ga³⁺ atoms. In the second Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom. In the third Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom.
